custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the hand anatomy. AI models frequently fail at rendering hands holding objects. If the fingers look fused or the nails are missing/misshapen, this is a strong indicator of AI generation. Also, critically evaluate the snake's head shape: Green Mambas have a very distinct, long, coffin-shaped head. If the head is short and blunt, it may be a misclassified species (e.g., a green vine snake or juvenile rat snake) generated by an AI that only captured the 'green snake' concept but failed the specific species morphology.
